derivation: A two-branch block's branch-1 head is the entry of a loop wholly inside that branch: loop-head routes to loop-tail, which chooses CONTINUE back to loop-head or EXIT to the block join. COMPOSITION admits a parallel branch head whose only incoming edge other than the block's implicit edge is an admitted back edge wholly inside that branch, and admits a cycle contained wholly inside one branch. The root's matching effect enters the split. LIFE-017 creates both branch obligations and occurrences atomically. COMPOSITION's loop rule gives every operation occurrence in the loop one LOOP segment, with branch segments in their outer-to-inner positions, and entry from outside allocates pass 1. The loop-head occurrence's enclosing path is therefore its BRANCH segment followed by the LOOP segment at pass 1; outer-b carries only its BRANCH segment. The ROUTE detail names the root's relationship to the split and the block.
